errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many invalid attempts. Wait a few minutes.
errors.updateCheckFailed: The remote PC could not reach GitHub to look for updates. Check its internet connection and try again later.
pairing.noApprover: Nobody is using the remote PC to allow the connection. Sign in to it, or pair with a token from its WRApperture (Host) app.
pairing.noWindow: The remote PC could not show the confirmation window. Pair with a token from its WRApperture (Host) app.
pairing.limited: Too many pairing requests right now. Wait a few minutes and try again.
pairing.notFound: Pairing request not found or already answered.
